description: This file defines the IStartupTask interface, which specifies a contract for actions to be performed after silo startup in Orleans runtime. It includes a single method Execute that takes a CancellationToken and returns a Task.

classes.name: IStartupTask
classes.description: An interface that defines an action to be taken after silo startup, with a method Execute that performs the task asynchronously.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the startup task asynchronously, accepting a CancellationToken to support cancellation.
